svg.title: How ORRERY cockpit and ORRERY Telemetry relate
svg.desc: Two screens onto the same agents: the cockpit operates terminals, Telemetry shows the dashboard and agent graph. The cockpit can embed the Telemetry screen. Agents run in tmux and talk through Mail.
svg.text: ORRERY = cockpit + Telemetry — two screens onto the same agents
also runs behind the scenes: Mail · hooks · /delegate
AGENTS — Claude Code / Codex, each in tmux
both screens show the same agents · agents talk to each other through Mail
they work in the project folder you chose
ORRERY's instructions: that folder's CLAUDE.md (Claude Code) · ~/.codex/AGENTS.md (Codex)
